reasons: Both answers meet every rubric item: each debunks the golden visa, proposes residencia no lucrativa, covers NIE/notary/registry with Valencia-specific ITP, and explains worldwide IRPF plus Modelo 720. B goes deeper on double-tax credit mechanics and filing details, but it makes an arithmetic error on the core income requirement (2,400 + 600 stated as 3,600/month), while A computes it correctly.
